tha-ap425:1.1: himavantassāvidūre → himavantassa avidūre (bj) | himavantassāvidūre gosito → himavantassa avidūre kasiko (sya-all)

tha-ap425:7.4: ajaro bhave → jajjaro bhavo (bj) | ajaro → jajjaro (cck: sī. pī. ka.)

tha-ap425:10.1: bhāyi → bhāyī (bj) | vissattho → visaṭṭho (cck); vissaṭṭho (sya-all) | vissattho → vissaṭṭho (bj: machasaṁ) | Visaṭṭho → vissattho (cck: sī. pī); vissaṭṭho (cck: syā. ka.)

tha-ap425:15.3: vīro → dhīro (bj) | abbhuggamī vīro → abbhuggami dhīro (sya-all)
tha-ap425:21.3: dhammapallaṅkamādāya → dhammapallaṅkamaññāya (sya-all) | Dhammapallaṅkamādāya → dhammapallaṅkamaññāya (cck: syā. ka.)
